items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: The alto saxes it states here as Cleve Bottoms and Van Sherrill.

ctx.x: -- a-n-t. Ed Fant. I also had a great saxophonist, but of this who eventually became great that wasn't named in that (inaudible). I don't know why.
The alto saxes it states here as Cleve Bottoms and Van Sherrill.
Van Sherrill is out of Toledo, Ohio. He's a mortician now, and he was a great good saxophonist. But that isn't the one I'm speaking of.
